Date: Sun, 18 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps - Private/VPC architecture review for FinPay

Hi Peter,

Thanks again for the excellent discovery call this morning. Quick recap of what we heard on your side:
- High throughput inference for transactional risk scoring (p99 latency target ~150ms)
- Strict data isolation requirements; preference for VPC with customer-managed KMS
- A need for predictable capacity during peak close windows (monthly batch windows)

Next step: schedule a 60-75 minute architecture review with our solutions engineering and infra team to walk through the VPC deployment options (VPC peering vs. Private deployment), networking/firewall requirements, and HSM/KMS integration. Proposed agenda:
1) Goals & constraints (10m)
2) High-level infra options & tradeoffs (20m)
3) Network, security, and data flow (20m)
4) Questions, next steps, and mutual action plan (10-15m)

Available slots (PST): Tue 3/20 11:00-12:15, Wed 3/21 14:00-15:15, Thu 3/22 09:00-10:15. If none of these work, send a couple of times that do and we will adapt. Can you also confirm the security contact you want on the call?

I attached a short mutual action plan and our VPC checklist to help guide the discussion.

Attachments: redwood-ma-plan.pdf, vpc-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
